description: This Java source file defines a REST API resource class 'SearchApiResource' for the Fineract project. It provides endpoints for retrieving adhoc search query templates, performing resource searches, and executing advanced, parameterized queries related to portfolio data such as clients, loans, and groups.

classes.name: SearchApiResource
classes.description: REST controller class exposing search-related endpoints for portfolio data.

methods.name: retrieveAdHocSearchQueryTemplate
methods.description: Returns a template for adhoc search queries.

methods.name: searchData
methods.description: Performs a resource search based on query parameters such as query string, resource types, and exact match flag.

methods.name: advancedSearch
methods.description: Executes an advanced, parameterized search based on JSON payload describing multiple search criteria.
